sheets.title: MULTIPURPOSE BUILDING FLOOR PLAN — CONCEPT C
sheets.reading_notes: Single-story floor plan at 3/32"=1'-0". Overall dimensions 86'-4" wide x 131'-6" tall. Program includes stage with prop storage, custom storage, and under-stage storage; full basketball court with two half-court arcs (one painted circle visible); indoor rock wall area on west side; men's and women's restrooms on east side with lobby entry; storage room at south. Sheet is stamped by both Bowman Foster & Associates (Norfolk/Arlington VA) and Andre Marquez Architects. Client logos for Melwood and Children's National Hospital visible — suggests Children's National is a funding partner or program co-sponsor. No MEP content on this sheet.

sheets.title: CLASSROOM BUILDING FLOOR PLAN — CONCEPT C
sheets.reading_notes: Single-story floor plan at 1/8"=1'-0". Overall dimensions 68'-8" wide x 65'-0" tall. Program includes Music Studio, Arts & Craft Studio, Photography Studio, Stor/Kiln Room, Pottery Studio, General Storage, and bathrooms (shown top right). Same team stamps as SDA-001. IBC occupancy classified as I-4 (per fire protection memo). The RFP calls this building 'Activity/Multipurpose' with classroom uses; drawings label it 'Classroom Building' — see conflict note below.

sheets.title: PROPOSED LAYOUT — MULTIPURPOSE ACTIVITY BUILDING (Schematic Bubble Diagram)
sheets.reading_notes: Schematic bubble/block diagram showing room relationships for the Activity Building (note: this is NOT the same as SDA-001). Shows Stage with Props Closet and Costume Closet and access ramps; Basketball Court; Indoor Rock Wall; Music Room; Arts/Crafts Room; Pottery Room; Photography Room; Foam Pit/Obstacle Course Room; Bathrooms w/ Adult Changing Tables; Storage Space. This appears to be an earlier conceptual layout or owner-provided program diagram, distinct from the Concept C architectural drawings SDA-001/SDA-002 which show a different room arrangement. Reconciliation: the gym/basketball building (SDA-001) absorbed the main court; the Classroom Building (SDA-002) absorbed the arts/crafts/pottery/photo/music program. Some rooms in the bubble diagram (Foam Pit/Obstacle Course Room) do not appear in SDA-001 or SDA-002 — flagged.

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: ROM Cost Estimate and drawing set (three buildings)
conflict_flags.rationale: The RFP was issued April 2025; by the time drawings were prepared (Feb 2026) and the ROM was produced (April 2026), the scope had evolved from two buildings to three. The Activity/Multipurpose function was split into a gymnasium/activity building (SDA-001) and a classroom/arts building (SDA-002). The three-building scope represents the current state of the project at extraction time.
